# OverWatch: The Physical AI Interlock & StandBy Desk Companion

> OverWatch is an open-source physical hardware security interlock and OLED StandBy desk deck for autonomous coding agents (Google Antigravity, Claude Code). It transforms an idle smartphone on a MagSafe stand into an out-of-band physical authorization token and ambient developer workstation monitor.

- Canonical Website: https://overwatch.adilrahman.cc/
- GitHub Repository: https://github.com/adil-rahman-3063/OverWatch
- Creator: Adil Rahman (https://adilrahman.cc)
- License: MIT License (Open Source)

---

## 1. What is an AI Hardware Interlock?
An AI hardware interlock is an out-of-band physical security gateway that decouples command approval from the primary computer monitor. When an autonomous coding agent (such as Google Antigravity or Claude Code) proposes a terminal execution or filesystem modification, the interlock halts the process via local IPC and routes authorization to a separate physical device. It enforces a strict fail-closed boundary: if the operator does not explicitly authorize the action, execution is terminated immediately.

---

## 2. Core Capabilities & Architecture

### Fail-Closed Security Gateway
- **Loopback IPC Server**: Listens locally on `127.0.0.1:49152` with sub-5ms round-trip latency.
- **PreToolUse Lifecycle Hook**: Intercepts tool calls via stdin JSON from Antigravity and Claude Code CLI.
- **Fail-Closed Law**: Unanswered prompts time out in 20 seconds and exit with code 1 (`decision: "deny"`). If the daemon is offline, phone disconnected, or network drops, execution is strictly blocked with zero fallback to blind execution.
- **Ephemeral Transit**: Realtime communication uses Supabase Realtime WebSocket broadcast channels (`overwatch:{device_id}`). Zero command logs, code snippets, or user keystrokes are stored in persistent databases.

### The Four OLED StandBy Screens
1. **Mechanical Split-Flap Clock**: 1960s departure board nostalgia with 3D CSS perspective downward folding and zero-latency Web Audio API mechanical sound synthesis (2600Hz Q=3.2 plastic flap slap + 220Hz→50Hz chassis thud). Includes Focus Sprint Timer.
2. **AI Mission Control & Interlock**: Displays live agent status, model name (e.g. Gemini 3.8 Flash High), step counts, token metrics (input, output, cache), and recent terminal actions. Features an audible chime and physical Allow/Deny buttons.
3. **Windows GSMTC Media & Hardware Telemetry**: Native Windows WinRT media controller interacting with `Windows.Media.Control.GlobalSystemMediaTransportControlsSessionManager`. Commands are scoped to specific player session indices (Spotify, Chrome YouTube Music, Edge), completely eliminating accidental playback of paused browser video tabs. Displays real-time CPU and RAM utilization.
4. **Workstation Macros & Universal Clipboard Beam**: Bi-directional clipboard bridge allowing 1-tap beaming of text snippets or mobile camera captures to Windows PC, plus native Windows Lock (`rundll32.exe`) and terminal launch shortcuts.

---

## 3. Comparison: OverWatch vs Desktop Popups vs Blind Auto-Approve

| Security Model | Approval Location | Timeout Behavior | Offline State | Workstation Interruption | Security Risk |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **OverWatch Physical Interlock** | Mobile StandBy Desk Stand | Fail-Closed (Exit 1) | Strict Block (Zero Run) | None (Silent glance on phone) | Negligible (Physical 2FA) |
| **Desktop IDE Dialogs** | Laptop / PC Monitor | Blocks IDE window | Desktop only | Steals mouse/keyboard focus | High (Operator fatigue) |
| **Blind Auto-Approve Flags** | None (Unrestricted) | Executes immediately | Unprotected | None | Extreme (Prompt injection) |

---

## 4. Setup & Installation Guide

### Prerequisites
- Windows 10 or Windows 11 (64-bit)
- Node.js 18.0.0 or higher
- Git for Windows

### 1-Click Automated Setup
```powershell
git clone https://github.com/adil-rahman-3063/OverWatch.git
cd OverWatch
.\setup.bat
```
Or via PowerShell:
```powershell
powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\setup.ps1
```

### Antigravity IDE Configuration (Mobile Interlock Mode)
1. Open Antigravity IDE.
2. Press `Ctrl+,` to open Antigravity Settings.
3. Navigate to **General** ➔ **Global Permissions**.
4. In the **Permission preset** dropdown, select **Auto**.
5. Antigravity now delegates all terminal tool calls to OverWatch on `127.0.0.1:49152`.

---

## 5. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

### What happens if my phone dies or Wi-Fi drops?
OverWatch operates on a strict fail-closed law. If the companion phone is offline, disconnected, or unresponsive for 20 seconds, the IPC hook immediately responds with `decision: "deny"`, safely halting agent execution.

### Does OverWatch upload my source code or terminal commands to cloud databases?
No. OverWatch uses an ephemeral, broadcast-only Supabase Realtime channel (`overwatch:{device_id}`). Payloads exist in volatile memory only during the active approval window and are purged immediately. Screen captures and clipboard items are stored strictly on the local machine (`Pictures/OverWatch/`).

### Can an AI agent bypass the OverWatch interlock?
No. The PreToolUse hook is registered in the IDE harness before the terminal executes commands. Without a cryptographic `allow` handshake returned from `127.0.0.1:49152`, the operating system process is never spawned.

### Which coding agents are supported?
Google Antigravity (native Auto mode preset) and Claude Code CLI. Any agent or CLI harness supporting PreToolUse stdin/stdout JSON hooks can connect to the OverWatch local IPC gateway.

### What is the power consumption of the OLED StandBy deck?
On OLED displays, individual black pixels (`#000000`) emit zero light and consume zero watts. In typical desk standby mode, battery drain is minimal (under 5% per hour with display permanently awake).
